meta.name: scenario-planning
meta.description: Plans under genuine uncertainty — building scenarios, identifying which assumptions are load-bearing, setting early-warning indicators, and stress-testing a plan against futures rather than forecasting one. Use this when a decision depends on something unknowable, when a plan assumes conditions that may not hold, before a large irreversible commitment, or when a market, regulatory, or technology shift could invalidate the strategy.

copy.tagline: 为不确定的未来准备可应变的计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果重大决定可能因不可知的变化而失效。
copy.tagline_en: Stress-test your plans against uncertain futures
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to make decisions when the future is unknowable.

howto.what: 装上后，它会帮你把计划从“预测一个未来”改成“应对多种未来”。它会列出假设，找出最关键的不确定因素，构建三四个情景并命名，逐个检验计划是否可行，产出稳健行动、或有行动和期权，并设定可观测的预警指标。
howto.when: 当决策依赖未知因素、计划假设可能不成立，或准备做重大不可逆承诺前等情形，会触发情景规划。

say.text: 我准备投资一个新市场，帮我做情景规划，别只预测一种未来。
say.note: Claude 会构建几种情景并给出应对行动。

say.text: 我的扩张计划假设利率不变，请列出关键假设并做压力测试。
say.note: 它会找出承重假设，逐个情景检验。

say.text: 为这个项目设定早期预警指标，并安排复查时间。
say.note: 指标触发时你会收到重新规划的提醒。

howto.what_en: Claude turns planning from forecasting one future into preparing for many. It flags key uncertainties, builds 3-4 named scenarios, stress-tests each, and suggests robust moves, contingent moves, options, and early-warning indicators.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a decision depends on unknowable factors, when plan assumptions may not hold, before a large irreversible commitment, or when a market, regulatory, or technology shift could invalidate the strategy.

say_en.text: I'm entering a new market; help me plan scenarios, not just one forecast.
say_en.note: Claude builds scenarios and suggests actions.

say_en.text: My expansion plan assumes rates stay flat; list key assumptions and test.
say_en.note: It flags key assumptions and stress-tests each scenario.

say_en.text: Set early-warning indicators for this project and schedule reviews.
say_en.note: You'll be reminded to replan when an indicator fires.
